canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Halia Jora: 30-year-old man, 152 cm (very-short), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-4-medium. Face: heart-shaped face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: a small throat necklace; one asymmetric ear cuff; a dense freckle field. Make body construction and habitual posture the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: deliberately tousled but clean. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
